text:
Alex: FYI we got a support ticket: new users on the sample onboarding flow see lots of 429s during the first paginated fetch.
Alex: App prefetches next 6 pages concurrently to make the UI snappy.
Priya (sdk): Which SDKs are in use? We recently shipped a change to allow higher prefetch in python (v1.6.x).
Alex: Backend uses python-sdk v1.6.2, front-end uses js-sdk v1.4.0.
Marco (platform): Pulled a request: headers show X-RI-Quota: 2/60, X-RI-Reset: 44, Retry-After: 3.
Casey (oncall): Low quota + N concurrent prefetch + overlapping token refresh = a congestion spike.
Alex: Also noticed duplicate refreshes in logs: multiple greenlets attempted token refresh at once.
Priya (sdk): Oh — JS coalesces refreshes, python doesn't. Parity bug. In python we need a refresh-in-progress guard.
Priya (sdk): Quick mitigation plan: 1) change default PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY to 2 for trial accounts, 2) add auth refresh coalescing, 3) respect Retry-After before retrying.
Marco (platform): We can add edge-side soft smoothing for UI-origin traffic (5s window) while the SDK patch rolls out.
Alex: Users also hit a 401 cascade when refreshes failed concurrently.
Priya (sdk): PR outline:
```
# pseudo
refresh_lock = get_lock_for(credential_id)
with refresh_lock:
    if token_expired():
        do_refresh()
# on 429: parse Retry-After, backoff to at least that value
```
Marco (platform): Can SDK parse X-RI-Quota and switch to a conservative mode when remaining<=3? e.g., limit concurrency=1.
Alex: For the sample app I've added PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 env and disabled background prefetch for trials.
ratebot: deploy-staging succeeded: sample-app @ 2025-12-04T14:00:15Z
Casey (oncall): Action items: - Priya: sdk hotfix (auth dedupe + retry-after) ETA 5h - Marco: edge smoothing toggle for trial bucket ETA 1.5h - Alex: sampleapp env flip + user comms ETA 30m - Casey: incident note + follow-up ETA 2h
Priya (sdk): I'll also add a warning log when X-RI-Quota indicates low remaining so integrators see it during dev.
Marco (platform): Note: consider idempotency keys for prefetch requests to avoid double-counting on retries.
Alex: Good call. Also adding an onboarding doc tip: "If on trial, set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY<=2 and enable SDK auth coalescing."
Priya (sdk): I'll open PR and include unit+integration tests simulating concurrent refresh + low-quota 429.
Casey (oncall): Keep me posted in this thread. If the patch doesn't cut, we'll roll the edge smoothing more conservative.
Alex: Thanks team 44d
